column1: # What Layer Bc (scripts/c11-lane.sh) does not pass, each with what it gives, in one of
# three forms by the second column:
#   <header>    a unit that does not compile: the first error its compile gives, as the
#               header the error is in and its words, without path or position.
#   undefined   a unit that compiles and leaves undefined what no freestanding image
#               has: those symbols, sorted, separated by one space. The unit is weighed.
#   generate    a document of sources/ the generator refuses, keyed by its path: the
#               words of the generator's first error, without the file and position it
#               names. The document is left out of the set and generated alone, with the
#               arguments the set takes, where it must be refused with these words.
# Columns: unit or document, form, words, why.
# A unit or document named here and failing with these words is not a failure. One named
# here that passes, or fails with other words, is: the row is removed or corrected in the
# commit that changes it, so the table only shrinks by the fix it waits for, and a second
# fault cannot hide behind the first.
# The rows of the form <header> wait for one defect of SCE's C11 generator, found by this
# lane at the pin it was written with (vendor/sce e90c0b6271b): a codec document that
# imports another codec under an alias other than the imported codec's own name (wz's
# documents import ext_unit.scxml as codec_zenoh_ext_unit, the name SCE's fixture of it
# has) is emitted with the imported type named by the name (ext_unit_t) and its decode
# called by the alias (codec_zenoh_ext_unit_decode), which no header declares. The Rust
# emission of the same documents resolves the alias. A unit is listed when its header
# includes one such codec, itself or through what it imports.
